input.brief: Sokka Map is a mobile app that saves places from TikTok and Instagram videos onto a personal map. It helps travelers actually use their saved restaurant and cafe recommendations.
input.focus: Turn saved places into a real dinner plan

study.brief: Sokka Map is a mobile app that saves places from TikTok and Instagram videos onto a personal map. It helps travelers actually use their saved restaurant and cafe recommendations.
study.promise: Find a dinner spot on your personal map from the restaurant recommendations you saved on TikTok and Instagram.
study.question: When travelers are ready for dinner, what stops them from finding and choosing a restaurant they previously saved on TikTok or Instagram?
study.overview: The references support location uncertainty and the gap between food inspiration and choosing somewhere to eat. None directly shows someone retrieving a previously saved restaurant video. The strongest direction for Sokka Map is turning remembered recommendations into a dinner choice on a personal map.
searchNotes: Assessment uses only the supplied frames, captions and transcripts. Indexed images are not assumed to be opening frames.
Three sources offer adjacent needs; none demonstrates the exact saved-video retrieval problem. Two sources are irrelevant, and one offers a transferable dialogue format.
The proposed angles are creative concepts, not observed user findings or evidence of product performance.
Views and interactions are source snapshots, not proof of conversion.
6 candidates inspected across visual and phrase-based searches.

references.title: A recommendation with multiple locations
references.creator: shermanator209
references.caption: @eatmazra ❤️
references.transcript: Mazra in Redwood City is hands down my favorite restaurant in the Bay Area. I'm meeting two of my friends here to celebrate all three of our birthdays. Mazra also has another location up in San Bumo by the San Francisco Airport. That one was closed for almost a year to do a major renovation. Our usual order is the family packed kebab plate. The baba-ganish dip is a smoked eggplant side dish and is my absolute favorite. The hummus is also delish. This restaurant is usually super busy, but once they found out a regular VIP and celebrity customer is coming, we magically got bumped up to the very top of the line. Just waiting for my friends to show up. They are Stanford students so they're taking the Caltrain here. We are finally here. Got seated right away. Customer service and ambience is always great. Salad is delicious as well. Oh my goodness, the entire staff even came out with a can of baklava and sing happy birthday to us. Happy birthday to all four of us. Isn't it such a coincidence we all share the same birthday? Laugh out loud.

angles.title: Where Was That Risotto?
angles.label: Inspiration to location
angles.description: Open with a traveler remembering a specific dish from a saved video. Show the restaurant on their Sokka Map, then the decision to go there for dinner.
angles.whyItFits: Specific food is an easy visual memory cue. The proposed tension is remembering the dish while needing the restaurant's location; that tension is inferred, not demonstrated in the reference.
angles.evidence: The Ciclo reference names fish maw risotto, shows two people introducing the outing, and supplies a full Causeway Bay address in its caption.
angles.suggestedHook: “I remember the risotto. Where was the restaurant?”
angles.visualDirection: Use a quick food-video glimpse, a sidewalk reaction, and a readable personal-map shot. End at the chosen restaurant entrance.

angles.title: Dinner Around Here
angles.label: Location-first choice
angles.description: Show a traveler ready to eat in their current neighborhood. Move from saved food inspiration to choosing a restaurant from their personal map.
angles.whyItFits: The strongest observed friction is that a social recommendation can be geographically unsuitable. Sokka Map's stated promise supports making a location-aware choice from places the traveler already saved.
angles.evidence: The lunch-challenge creator says a broad search could return Scotland or somewhere hours away, searches the current area instead, and describes the selected restaurant as a 15-minute walk.
angles.suggestedHook: “Saved loads of restaurants. Which ones are around here?”
angles.visualDirection: Start with a sidewalk selfie and a clear location question. Cut to saved restaurant pins on Sokka Map, select one, and show the traveler arriving.

angles.title: You Saved It. Where Is It?
angles.label: Two-person dialogue
angles.description: Build a short exchange between travel companions: one remembers a recommendation, the other asks where it is. Resolve the question with their personal restaurant map.
angles.whyItFits: The travel skit's question-and-answer structure makes a planning gap understandable quickly. The restaurant reference supplies a concrete reason location details matter, since one recommendation discusses multiple branches.
angles.evidence: The travel transcript includes a question about whether Paolo checked the map and his negative answer. The Mazra transcript names Redwood City and mentions another location near San Francisco Airport.
angles.visualDirection: Use a tight two-person sidewalk shot, a brief pause after the question, then a close-up of Sokka Map and a shared decision.

storyboard.title: Dinner Around Here
storyboard.premise: A traveler turns remembered food recommendations into tonight's dinner using their personal map.
storyboard.hook: “Saved loads of restaurants. Which ones are around here?”

scenes.visual: Evening sidewalk selfie. The traveler glances between the street and their phone. Display the hook as on-screen text.
scenes.voiceover: “I've saved so many restaurant videos. Where should we eat tonight?”

scenes.visual: Close-up of saved restaurant videos, including an appealing dish. The traveler pauses on one.
scenes.voiceover: “I remember this dish. Now I need to find the place.”

scenes.visual: Show Sokka Map with the traveler's saved restaurant locations. Tap a pin to identify a dinner option.
scenes.voiceover: “Sokka Map puts my saved restaurant recommendations on my personal map. Let's try this one.”

scenes.visual: The traveler reaches the chosen restaurant and walks inside. End card: Sokka Map — Your saved spots. Tonight's dinner.
scenes.voiceover: “From saved for later to tonight's dinner. Find your next dinner spot with Sokka Map.”

storyboard.callToAction: Find tonight's dinner on your Sokka Map.
